verdict.rationale: Lorikeet Coach is described as delivering conversational insights and analytics inside the product: it reviews 100% of tickets against quality standards and either implements improvements or suggests fixes for you to action, and you can talk to it directly in Lorikeet. Knowledge-base audits and ticket replays also surface gaps and projected resolution quality from your own data. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of what Coach's in-app insights and suggestions look like (only marketing-level claims), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
